generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of KPPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.
Tender invited only for eligible contractors registered under Karnataka Public Works Dept

The Tenderer shall obtain the workdone certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer(District Level Officer)and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid.
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty first day of March of succeeding year(both days inclusive)
All the documents to be uploaded shall be neatly scanned and the documents scanned shall be in original.
The tenderer shall note that the scanned Documents can also be uploaded in the tasks created under Document/Evidence Required from the Bidder
The Employer reserves the right to Reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP portal

Tenderer shall note that the Tenders of those found Eligible as mentioned in Clause 3 - Qualification of the Tenderer in Section 2 : Instructions to Tenderers (ITT), will only be considered for evaluation.
All materials required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities at his own cost before use on work.

The items quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on constructive materials and other taxes as per the rates prevailing Govt Orders at the time of execution and including all the cost and conveyance of all materials, curing, loading and unloading with all lead and lifts, labour, hire charges of machinery and equipments, etc., complete and all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders

All the Formats prescribed in the bid documents shall be filled in complete manner. ( section 3 & 4 of the bid document ) and shall be uploaded properly, signed by Tenderer . Necessary Certificates shall be uploaded along with the formats wherever required. General documents Section can be used for this purpose.
Department will not supply any materials.
The cost of the Tender form shall not be refundable.

Further particulars, if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD Division Belagavi during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happened next working day will holds good in lieu of the dates mentioned.

The contractor should employ only registered labours as per Govt. Circular No. PWD/198/BMS/2009/ Dated: 24-06-2009. As per EPF & MP act 1952 in respect of the employees engaged by or through contractors, agencies and contractors shall have provident fund code no. & all the contract employees deployed by them are enrolled as members of provident fund.

As per Karnataka State Govt Order No:LD/300/LET/2006/Bangalore Dt: 1-1-2007 and Govt Ltr No:PW/134/BMS/2007, Dt: 27-7-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund.

THE CONTRACTORS ARE INSTRUCTED TO SUBMIT ONLY RELEVENT INFORMATION WITH RECORDS AS REQUIRED AND SPECIFIED IN QUALIFICATION CRITERIA.ANY JUNK ,SUPERFLUOS AND UNNECESARY DOCUMENTS IF UPLOADED WILL TREATED AS MISLEADING AND SUCH TENDERS ARE LIABLE TO BE REJECTED.
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delays as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria.
Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) from Practicing Chartered Account is Preferred
The Project Completion period is 11 Months and the Tenderer should maintain work till the finalisation of agency for the nextannual maintenance of road work for the year 2027-2028(Including monsoon)

Appeal: As per the Govt. Ltr. No. 572/CRM/2020/PWD-COMM-1-PWD-SEC, dated 09.10.2020 the appeal received in e-Procurement KPPP portal as per KTPP Act / Rules within the stipulated time will only be considered. Any written Appeal Received shall not be considered.
Tenderer should be Registered in KPWD registered Class-III and Above Contractor and copy should be uploaded in E-portal Attested by the Gazzeted officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer.
The item rates are excluding GST but inclusive of all other charges.
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately.
Any deviation/error/mistake found in units of items, they should be read as in the unified SR 2023-24(Contd for 2026-27) and the rates shall be quoted accordingly.
This Bid Document clause no 34.4 to be implemented as per Delegation of Power vide GO NO.PWD 423 FC-1 2018 Bangalore, Dated:24/09/2018
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected.
Bidders are requested to read the Bid Documents before submission of their bid.

The intending tenderer is instructed to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-3 of Finance department and further orders there on.

The Bidder, at his own cost, responsibility and risk, is encouraged to visit, examine and familiarize himself with the Site of Works and its surroundings including source of earth, water, road aggregates, availability of labor etc. and obtain all information that may be necessary for preparing the Bid and entering into a contract for undertaking the maintenance Works. The costs of visiting the site shall be at the Bidders own expense. The following certificate/Affidavit shall be undertaken by contractor during the submission of tenders, I have inspected the road and I am ready to maintain the road till end of tender period.

The Contractor shall maintain the Road Assets in proper condition that comply with the Road Maintenance Standards and ensure road users safety and comfort.The maintenance activities shall be so planned that the defects are repaired well before they reach maximum condition asper the permissible tolerance. After issuing the work order the contractor should complete 25% of the length every month.
If the contractor has not done the maintenance work satisfactorily in previous years such bids will be rejected
If no bid received auto extension will be done by KPPP itself for 3 days.

As per Government Circular No. FD/263/EXP-12/2022, Dated 11/05/2022 Tender Clause ITT 24.3. If Successful Bidder not made Agreement with Employer then the EMD Amount will be forfeited and Tender will Rejected

As per Government Circular No. PWD/48/BMS/2022, Dated 31/05/2024 and KTPP 2000 Rules 26(A) contractor are liable for debarment if contractor does bad quality of work, if contractor fails to complete the work within stipulated period of time and also to follow all other conditions mentioned in the above said Government circular.

The Tenderer shall scan the Original Ownership Documents/ Lease/ Hire committement Agreement for the Machinery and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced at the time of opening of technical Bids for physical verification.

As per Govt. Circular No. FD 417 Exp-12/2024, dt. 09.08.2024 in case of revision of GST rates during the contract period, the Government and the contractor are bound to make payment / refund accordingly.
Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) for Practicing Chartered Account is Preffered
The contractor shall maintain the road in proper and traffic-worthy condition throughout the maintenance period.
All potholes, cracks, depressions, edge damages and other defects shall be repaired immediately after they are noticed or as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.
The carriageway, shoulders, drains, and other road appurtenances shall be kept clean and free from obstruction
The contractor shall provide necessary labour, materials, machinery, tools and equipment required for maintenance at his own cost
Maintenance works shall be carried out as per the directions of the Engineer-in-Charge and in accordance with the applicable PWD specifications and standards.
The contractor shall be responsible for maintaining the road in a safe and serviceable condition until completion of the specified maintenance period.

technicalCriterionList.description: Tenderers who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under Assessed available tender capacity equal to (AxNx2.5 - B) A equal to Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. 0.917 Year where B equal to Value at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 0.917 Year form the probable date of Award of this contract.

As per this note each tenderer should further demonstrate Availability of key equipment/ machinery for execution of the work. However as per Govt Circular no GOFDAE 263EXP122022 dt 11 052022 this clause for owning key equipment for works costing upto Rs 3.00 Crores is exempted. However it is obligatory for the contractor to use the fallowing machineries for various activities involved in construction as per MORTH specifications. Tippers-1 Own, 1-Hire, Hot Mix Plant(40/60 TPH)-1 Own,Vibratory Road Roller-1 Own 1-Hire, Paver Finisher-1 Own and Water Tanker-2 Hire

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Annual Maintenance of Arabhavi-Challakere Road (SH-45) from Km. 25.83 to 79.05 in Savadatti Yallamma Constituency of Belagavi District under HoA 3054 SH Maintenance for the year 2026-2027

itemList.description: Clearing    and    grubbing    road    land    including    uprooting    rank vegetation,  grass,  bushes,  shrubs,  saplings  and  trees  girth  up  to 300  mm,  removal  of  stumps  of  trees  cut  earlier  and  disposal  of unserviceable  materials  and  stacking  of  serviceable  material  to be used or auctioned,  including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer - In area of light jungle

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Drains - The maintenance of drains include erosion, repair, clearing, cleaning,  reshaping,  regrading,  deepening  of  side  drains as well as catch water drains as per technical specification Clause 1908. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1908
Maintenance of Earth Shoulder (stripping excess soil) - Stripping excess soil from the shoulder surface to achieve the approved level and compacting with plate compactor. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003

Maintenance of Earthen Shoulder (filling with fresh soil) - Making  up  loss  of  material/  irregularities  on  shoulder  to  the design level by adding fresh approved soil and compacting it with appropriate equipment.Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 3003

Patching of Potholes - Patching of Shallow Potholes using SDBC Gr II 25 mm thick - Patching  of  shallow  potholes  on  asphalt  surfaces  by  using Semi Dense Bituminous Concrete 25mm thickness. The Cost is inclusive of removing the failed materials & cleaning on the road surface, preparation of potholes to the required standards sizes before patching them and application of tack coat at 0.20 kg/ m2 over the asphalt surface including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification.

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of 200 m and km stones - Maintenance of 200 m & km stones by way of refiting of tilted stones  repairing  with  cement  mortar,  cleaning,  repairing and lettering on 200 m & km stone and  5th km stone as per drawing and technical specification. -Painting two coats with synthetic enamel paint. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1913

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of 200 m and km stones - Maintenance of 200 m & km stones by way of refiting of tilted stones  repairing  with  cement  mortar,  cleaning,  repairing and lettering on 200 m & km stone and  5th km stone as per drawing and technical specification. -Printing  letters  and  figures  of  any  shade  with  synthtic enamel  paint  of  any  approved  colour  to  give  an  even shade. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1913

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: White  washing  of  parapet  walls  of  CD  work  and  tree trunks - White washing two coats on parapet walls and tree trunks including preparation of surface by cleaning scraping etc. as per technical specifications. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1916

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -16- PANCHAYATH RAJ ENGINEERING DEPARTMENT ITEMS
itemList.description: Maintenance of Culverts - Maintenance  of  Hume  pipe  Culvert  by  way  of    Clearing, Cleaning, Erosion repair, repairs to cracks, parapet wall and protection work as per drawing and technical specification Clause 1909. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 1909

Painting on concrete surface - Providing and applying 2 coats of water based cement paint to unplastered concrete surface after cleaning the surface of dirt, dust, oil, grease, efflorescence and applying paint @ of 1 litre for 2 m2.. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 800

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Road Marking with Hot Applied Thermoplastic Compound with Reflectorising Glass Beads on Bituminous Surface - Providing  and  laying  of  hot  applied  thermoplastic compound 2.5 mm thick including reflectorising glass beads @ 250 g/m2 area, thickness of 2.5 mm is exclusive of surface applied glass beads  as  per  IRC:35:2015.The  finished  surface  to  be  level, uniform and free from streaks and holes. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 803

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -8- TRAFFIC CALMING MEASURES, ROAD SIGNAGES & MARKING (ROAD FURNITURE)
itemList.description: Supplying  and  Fixing  of  Molded  Shank  Raised  Pavement Markers / Cats Eye made of polycarbonate and ABS moulded body and reflective panels with micro prismatic lens capable of providing total internal reflection of the light entering the lens face and shall support a load of 16000 kg tested in accordance to  ASTM  D  4280  Type  H  and  complying  to  Specifications  of Category   A   of   MORTH   Circular   No   RW/NH/33023/10-97 DO III Dt 11.06. 1997. The height, width and length shall not exceed 50 mm, 100 mm and 102 +/- 2 mm and with minimum reflective  area  of  13  cm2  on  each  side  and  the  slope  to  the base shall be 35 +/- 5 degree. The strength of detachment of the  integrated  cylindrical  shanks,  (of  diameter  not  less  than 19  +/-  2  mm  and  height  not  less  than  30+/-  2  mm)  from the  body  is  to  be  a  minimum  value  of  500  Kg.  Fixing  will  be by  drilling  holes  on  the  road  for  the  shanks  to  go  inside, without  nails  and  using  epoxy  resin  based  adhesive  as  per manufacturers recommendation and complete as directed by the engineer.The contractor shall submit a two year warranty for    satisfactory    field    performance    including    stipulated retro-reflectance   of   the   reflecting   panel,   to   the   Engineer. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - MoRTH 806

Patching of Deep Potholes 75mm thick by restoring theGranular Base course using material confirming to WBM Grade -II with type B Screening standards wherever necessary by manual means including trimming the pothole to the required shape and size, cleaning the pothole, applying Prime Coat (SS1) at 0.70 kg per m2 over the WBM surface and covering the surface with SDBC 25mm thick including lead, loading unloading, rolling and finishing etc., complete as per specification.
